note_en: The text closes with a three-way "whether … or … or" built from 无论是…还是…抑或是…: 无论是去健身房办卡，还是在广场上跳舞，抑或是跟着手机App打卡 "whether it's buying a gym membership, dancing in a plaza, or logging workouts in an app." 抑或 is a bookish "or" that only appears in writing; in speech you would just repeat 还是. The main clause after the list then states what holds in every case, like English "no matter which."
